description: Record a payment for Invoice #INV-CONS-001 from customer 'Alfreds Futterkiste'. The total invoice amount is $1,000.00, but the customer has withheld $100.00 as tax. You must record a receipt that clears the full invoice amount ($1,000.00) by receiving $900.00 into 'Cash on Hand' and allocating the remaining $100.00 to the 'Withholding Tax Receivable' asset account. Ensure the invoice status becomes 'Paid in Full'.
